EV3 Block Lab 0.1.0 — 非公式の試作ツール。
LEGO、MINDSTORMS、SPIKEはLEGO Groupの商標です。このツールはLEGO Groupの承認・提供によるものではありません。

Blockly 13.4.0 is distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
The complete license is in vendor/LICENSE.
Project: https://github.com/RaspberryPiFoundation/blockly

The EV3 bytecode compiler and transport in ev3.js are an original implementation
of the publicly documented EV3 binary format and system command protocol.
References (not incorporated firmware code):
https://education.lego.com/en-us/product-resources/mindstorms-ev3/downloads/developer-kits/
https://github.com/mindboards/ev3sources
https://github.com/ev3dev/lmsasm
https://developer.chrome.com/blog/serial-over-bluetooth/

The app does not upload projects to an application server. Projects are kept in
browser localStorage and exported files. Hosting access logs may still exist.
